decision.summary: Urgent no-heating job, treated as emergency because the tenant is vulnerable and temperatures are 3-5C. HeatRight was assigned (first attempt failed, retry verified), then no-showed; I recorded the missed appointment, reassigned to Swift for the same day, informed tenant and landlord and escalated P1.

answers.question: What happened when you assigned the contractor and how did you verify it?
answers.answer: First assign_contractor attempt returned HTTP 500 and the ledger said NOT APPLIED (ticket still at init). I retried once; the read-back verified stage visit with HeatRight, 11 Oct 08:00-12:00 (A1 attempt 2). I told the tenant only after verification.

answers.question: What do you tell the tenant at each point?
answers.answer: After booking: HeatRight visiting 11 Oct 8-12, gas smell advice and 0800 111 999 (MSG-101). After no-show: apology, reassigned to Swift, target same day, window unconfirmed, update by 5pm (send timed out but read-back shows it was sent, MSG-102, not retried). All by email, his preference.

answers.question: After the no-show, what do you do?
answers.answer: Recorded missed_appointment, reassigned to Swift Plumbing & Heating (15:00-19:00), emailed landlord, scheduled follow-up, escalated P1 for phone confirmation and temporary heating fallback.
